answer: Shared Operator Liability Pool: each agent identity posts a small refundable deposit into a pool keyed to its verified operator credentials, not the wallet. Any sybil cluster flagged by cross-identity behavior analysis triggers a proportional draw on that operator's entire pool, including honest identities, creating a knoll of shared exposure. An attacker must register distinct operators at real cost to isolate risk, and one flagged cluster drains the oasis of pooled funds across all their identities.
